issue_context.title: disk by-path question/suggestion for usb storage devices
issue_context.body:
Hi, 

I was developing an application and noticed the following issue:

When a usb storage device is plugged in running ```udevadm info /dev/sdm``` generates following output:
```
P: /devices/pci0000:00/0000:00:1c.6/0000:14:00.0/usb6/6-1/6-1:1.0/host15/target15:0:0/15:0:0:0/block/sdm
N: sdm
L: 0
S: disk/by-path/pci-0000:14:00.0-usb-0:1:1.0-scsi-0:0:0:0
S: disk/by-id/usb-WD_Elements_25A3_564348564239414E-0:0
E: DEVPATH=/devices/pci0000:00/0000:00:1c.6/0000:14:00.0/usb6/6-1/6-1:1.0/host15/target15:0:0/15:0:0:0/block/sdm
E: DEVNAME=/dev/sdm
E: DEVTYPE=disk
E: MAJOR=8
E: MINOR=192
E: SUBSYSTEM=block
E: USEC_INITIALIZED=33762001
E: ID_VENDOR=WD
E: ID_VENDOR_ENC=WD\x20\x20\x20\x20\x20\x20
E: ID_VENDOR_ID=1058
E: ID_MODEL=Elements_25A3
E: ID_MODEL_ENC=Elements\x2025A3\x20\x20\x20
E: ID_MODEL_ID=25a3
E: ID_REVISION=1031
E: ID_SERIAL=WD_Elements_25A3_XXXXXXXXXX-0:0
E: ID_SERIAL_SHORT=XXXXXXXXXX
E: ID_TYPE=disk
E: ID_INSTANCE=0:0
E: ID_BUS=usb
E: ID_USB_INTERFACES=:080650:
E: ID_USB_INTERFACE_NUM=00
E: ID_USB_DRIVER=usb-storage
E: ID_PATH=pci-0000:14:00.0-usb-0:1:1.0-scsi-0:0:0:0
E: ID_PATH_TAG=pci-0000_14_00_0-usb-0_1_1_0-scsi-0_0_0_0
E: ID_PART_TABLE_UUID=bca046c6-1b56-4fa7-a04c-196631b4a867
E: ID_PART_TABLE_TYPE=gpt
E: DEVLINKS=/dev/disk/by-path/pci-0000:14:00.0-usb-0:1:1.0-scsi-0:0:0:0 /dev/disk/by-id/usb-WD_Elements_25A3_XXXXXXXXXX-0:0
E: TAGS=:systemd:
```
In ```DEVLINKS```, generated by-path value is ```/dev/disk/by-path/pci-0000:14:00.0-usb-0:1:1.0-scsi-0:0:0:0```. I checked the source code and in file ```systemd/src/udev/udev-builtin-path_id.c``` at line: ```496``` and saw that usb part has a fixed value of ```0```. 

```path_prepend(path, "usb-0:%s", port);```

Is there any particular reason why ```usb-0``` is a fixed value, but not bus id? Why its not ```usb-6``` or ```usb6``` according the output above. E.g ```/dev/disk/by-path/pci-0000:14:00.0-usb-6-1:1.0-scsi-0:0:0:0```
